$comment: Emergency phrase cards. Phrases are for native review; numbers and contacts are verified (see numbers.json and each card's contacts).

cards.title: Doctor
cards.intro: You feel ill or hurt and need a doctor. For anything life-threatening, call 155.

show.cs: Dobrý den, nemluvím dobře česky. Potřebuji lékaře. Můžete mi prosím pomoct?
show.en: Hello, I don't speak Czech well. I need a doctor. Can you please help me?

expect: Outside surgery hours, look for pohotovost (out-of-hours service).
Have your health insurance card with you.

cards.title: Pharmacy
cards.intro: You need medicine, or advice on what to take.

show.cs: Dobrý den, potřebuji něco na bolest. Nemluvím dobře česky.
show.en: Hello, I need something for pain. I don't speak Czech well.

phrases.en: Do you have anything for a cough?
Do you have anything for a headache?

expect: Prescriptions are electronic (eRecept): show the code from your text message or paper slip.

cards.title: Police
cards.intro: Something was stolen, or you need to report a crime. In an emergency, call 158.

show.cs: Dobrý den, chci nahlásit krádež. Nemluvím dobře česky.
show.en: Hello, I want to report a theft. I don't speak Czech well.

phrases.cs: Ztratil jsem pas. / Ztratila jsem pas.

phrases.en: I need a confirmation for my insurance.
Where is the nearest police station?

expect: 158 is the state police (Policie ČR); 156 is the city police (městská policie).

cards.title: Locked out
cards.intro: The door has shut behind you and the keys are inside.

show.cs: Dobrý den, zabouchl jsem si dveře a klíče jsou uvnitř. Potřebuji zámečníka.
show.en: Hello, I've locked myself out and the keys are inside. I need a locksmith.

phrases.cs: Zabouchl jsem si dveře. / Zabouchla jsem si dveře.

expect: Ask your landlord or the building administrator first: they may have a spare key.
Agree the price with a locksmith before they start.

cards.title: Lost something
cards.intro: You left something on a tram, a bus, the metro, or somewhere in town.

show.cs: Dobrý den, nechal jsem v tramvaji tašku. Můžete mi pomoct?
show.en: Hello, I left a bag on the tram. Can you help me?

phrases.cs: Ztratil jsem peněženku. / Ztratila jsem peněženku.
Nechal jsem to v tramvaji. / Nechala jsem to v tramvaji.
phrases.en: I left it on the tram. (man / woman)

phrases.cs: Byla to linka 22, asi v osm.
phrases.en: It was line 22, at about eight.

expect: If you've just left it on Prague public transport, call DPP straight away: they contact the driver.
Unclaimed items go to the city's lost-and-found office once a week (on Tuesdays).

contacts.label: DPP line, for items just left on Prague public transport
Ztráty a nálezy (lost and found), Karolíny Světlé 5, Praha 1

cards.title: Accident
cards.intro: Someone is hurt, or there's been a crash. Call 155 for injuries, 112 if you're unsure or several services are needed.

show.cs: Stala se nehoda. Je tu zraněný člověk. Zavolejte prosím záchranku!
show.en: There's been an accident. Someone is injured. Please call an ambulance!

phrases.en: We're at … (say the street or stop)

expect: Tell the operator what happened, where you are and how many people are hurt, then stay on the line.
